name: Keysmith
summary: A 6-digit code field where every digit cuts a notch in a key that must open a pin lock
about: A blueprint drawing of a key and a pin tumbler lock. Each digit you enter cuts a notch in the key, then the key slides into the lock and the pins drop into the notches. If every pin lands on the shear line the key turns; if not, the wrong pins glow red and the key comes back out.
how: Type, paste or autofill the 6-digit demo code; backspace and arrow keys move between cuts
A cutting wheel follows the box you are in and each digit cuts a notch with a spark
After the sixth digit the key slides into the lock and the pins settle into its notches
When all pins line up on the shear line it glows green and the key turns
If any pin is out of line it turns red, you are told how many are off and the key slides back out
